title: fix(console): a refused account link says why on the page the signed-in person lands on

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:已登录用户关联第三方/OIDC 账号时,如果对方账号的邮箱和自己的不一致,服务端回调拒绝关联并把浏览器送到 `/_console/login?error=email_does_not_match`。登录页现在把这个错误码带到用户落脚的页面,那里弹出一条错误提示(英文 "The account was not linked: its email address doesn't match the one on the account you're signed in with…",中文「该账号未关联：它的邮箱地址与你当前登录账号的邮箱地址不一致…」,共 11 种语言),提示一直留到用户关掉。
- 为什么改:用户仍处于登录状态,登录页从不显示表单,直接把人送回控制台首页,错误原因被丢掉,用户只看到「什么都没发生」。
- 风险与回滚:只有登录页认识的错误码(目前仅 `email_does_not_match`)会被带走,且只带错误码、不带 URL 里的任何文字;未登录访客看到的登录页文案不变;服务端拒绝行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/components/LinkRefusalNotice.tsx`(暂存与弹出);`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx` 中 `holdLinkRefusalForLanding(callbackError?.code)` 一处;`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` 的 `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.linkRefusalLanding-33063.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.linkRefusal-33063.test.tsx`,预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Where the reason was dropped (measured on `origin/main` 34c05229).** better-auth 1.7.12's `linkOAuthAccount` refuses a provider account whose email differs (`accountLinking.allowDifferentEmails` off) with `email_does_not_match`, and `redirectOnError` sends it to the platform error URL, which plugin-auth sets to the Console login page (`onAPIError.errorURL: this.getConsolePageUrl('/login')`). On that page the `callbackError` memo is read only by the signed-out form: with a user present, `signInNeeded` is false, the page renders its "Signing you in…" spinner, and the post-login effect leaves by `window.location.assign(withConsoleBase(redirect or '/'))` without it. The red-first run below drives exactly that: main's `LoginPage` and `App` land the person on `/apps/crm` and nothing says why.

- **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`**: a second map, `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS`, for codes a person who is already signed in arrives with. It holds one entry, `email_does_not_match` → `auth.login.errors.linkEmailMismatch`. `isSignedInLinkRefusal(code)` and `signedInLinkRefusalMessage(t, code)` read it the same way `ssoCallbackRefusalMessage` reads the sign-in map: known code → known sentence, nothing else.
- **`ui/apps/console/src/components/LinkRefusalNotice.tsx`** (new): `holdLinkRefusalForLanding(code)` keeps a known code in `sessionStorage` (this tab only) under `objectstack.console.linkRefusal`; an unknown code is not kept. `LinkRefusalNotice` takes the code out on mount (shown once), re-checks it against the map, and raises a `sonner` error toast whose body is a small component calling `useObjectTranslation`, so the sentence follows the person's language once it has loaded. The toast stays until closed (`duration: Infinity`, close button).
- **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`**: in the post-login effect, after the two hand-off exits (which leave the console) and before the organization and landing exits (which land in it), one call `holdLinkRefusalForLanding(callbackError?.code)`; `callbackError` joins the effect's dependency list.
- **`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`**: `LinkRefusalNotice` is mounted once, as the element right after `ConsoleToaster`, so the toaster is subscribed when it fires, and so it shows on whatever page the person lands on.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: `auth.login.errors.linkEmailMismatch` in all eleven locales (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33063-link-refusal-email-mismatch-notice.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, both declaration lines.

Not changed: the server, plugin-auth and better-auth (the refusal is correct and writes no account row); the signed-out login page's own sentences.

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.linkRefusalLanding-33063.test.tsx`: both legs through `App`'s real route tree. The real `LoginPage` at `/login?error=…` with a signed-in session in its active organization; the URL it hands `window.location.assign` is taken, everything is unmounted, and `App` is opened again at that URL (the full page load), with the real `ProtectedRoute`, `RootLandingRedirect` and `ConsoleToaster`. Only `sessionStorage` survives between the legs, as in the browser.

- signed in, `?error=email_does_not_match`: lands on `/` → `/apps/crm` as before, and the toast reads the English sentence; the slot is empty afterwards.
- the same under `zh-Hans`: the toast reads the zh-Hans row.
- CONTROL, signed in with no `error`: lands on `/apps/crm`, no notice, nothing held.
- CONTROL, signed in with `?error=%3Cimg%20src%3Dx%3E`: nothing held, no notice, the markup never reaches the DOM.

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.linkRefusal-33063.test.tsx` (real `LoginPage` over the real `AuthProvider`, as the #32992 file):

- CONTROL, signed out, `?error=access_denied`: the alert is #32992's sentence, the form is drawn, nothing is held.
- CONTROL, signed out, `?error=email_does_not_match`: the form and its alert are drawn, nothing is held for a landing.
- a slot value with no sentence (an HTML bold fragment reading `not a code`) is dropped on read and never shown.

`LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx` is unchanged and green.

**Red-first (the measurement)**: `LoginPage.tsx` and `App.tsx` restored to base `34c05229` (the hold call and the mount: 0 and 0 on disk), the new pins kept.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the reason lands.** The order preferred carrying the reason to where the person lands over holding a signed-in person on the login page. There is no Console page that starts a link (`sys_account` has deliberately no link action; linking is `POST /api/v1/auth/link-social` with a `callbackURL` the caller picks, and a refusal ignores that URL and goes to the login page), so the landing is the console root the login page already sends to. The notice is mounted at the app root and shows on whatever page that is.
- **Only the code travels.** `sessionStorage` holds the code, and the code is checked against the map both when it is kept and when it is read; the sentence comes from the locale pack.
- **Same family, not carried here.** better-auth's link step refuses with two more codes, `account_already_linked_to_different_user` and `unable_to_link_account` (`linkOAuthAccount` in better-auth 1.7.12 `oauth2/link-account.mjs`); a signed-in person who meets either lands with no word, exactly as before this PR. Each needs its own sentence in eleven locales; adding one is an entry in `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS` plus its key. Reported for the seat.
